content.text: {"root_cause": "report-builder v3.4.0 raised a 24Gi memory limit and shipped with a 2Gi request per container, putting the node at 29.4 GiB and sending it into OOMKills. ledger-service, which needs about 14Gi, was the only pod living within the request/limit boundary, so it was evicted and all 4 of its containers died. Every other service is healthy and responding at normal load.", "category": "resource-exhaustion", "action_id": "rollback_deploy"}
